pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal patches with softened edge gradients. Spatial distribution shows larger, elongated patches at the base of the neck transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower neck and shoulder regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a network of tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent with localized narrowing at the vertex of acute patch angles.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark-feathered avian (oxpecker) perched vertically on the mid-flank, creating a localized visual occlusion of the pelage.
